claim_type: structural dichotomy with certified germ models
limitations: Germ-level dichotomy only; both germs have vanishing 1-jet (abelian linearization) and lie outside the nondegenerate compact hypothesis. No compact one-point model and no global non-unimodularity proof are claimed.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: Sharp local (non-)unimodularity dichotomy at isolated rank-zero points in dimension 4
